commit.message:
Write velocity output in the input frame on rotated-pole meshes

When the momentum equations are solved in a rotated spherical frame
(ICS +/-22/24 with a fort.rotm rotation, IFSPROTS=1), the state
velocities UU2/VV2 hold components along the rotated coordinate axes.
The fort.61/62/63/64 writers passed them through untransformed, so
velocity time series and station output carried rotated-frame
components against geographic coordinates - directions wrong by up to
~90 degrees near the rotated poles, while every scalar (elevation,
speed, maxvel) looked correct. Meteorological output and the harmonic
analysis (which back-rotates before its least-squares update) were
already in the geographic input frame, so the file set was internally
inconsistent.

Velocity output is now re-expressed in geographic east/north before it
is written: UU2_GEO/VV2_GEO are allocated only when the rotated frame
is in use, bound to the global and station velocity descriptors in
place of UU2/VV2, and refreshed via the existing DRVMAP2DSPVEC inverse
transform at most once per time step and only on steps where a
velocity output is actually due.

Resolves #510

 C     including hotstart and harmonic analysis.

+C-----------------------------------------------------------------------
+C     S U B R O U T I N E
+C     U P D A T E  G E O G R A P H I C  O U T P U T  V E L O C I T Y
+C-----------------------------------------------------------------------
+C     When the momentum equations are solved in a rotated spherical
+C     frame (IFSPROTS = 1), the state velocities UU2/VV2 hold components
+C     along the rotated coordinate axes. Analysis-facing output
+C     (fort.62/fort.64 and their max files) is written in geographic
+C     east/north for consistency with the meteorological output and the
+C     harmonic analysis (see updateHarmonicAnalysis), so the components
+C     are re-expressed here before each output pass. Hotstart output is
+C     intentionally left in the rotated frame: it is internal state that
+C     must round-trip through a restart unchanged.
+C-----------------------------------------------------------------------
+      SUBROUTINE updateGeographicOutputVelocity()
+      USE GLOBAL, ONLY : UU2, VV2, UU2_GEO, VV2_GEO, IFSPROTS
+      USE MESH, ONLY : NP, DRVMAP2DSPVEC
+      IMPLICIT NONE
+      IF ( IFSPROTS.NE.1 ) RETURN
+      CALL DRVMAP2DSPVEC( UU2_GEO, VV2_GEO, UU2, VV2, NP,
+     &                    FWD = .FALSE. )
+      END SUBROUTINE updateGeographicOutputVelocity
